decisions.statement: The ring read here holds every visit the addon traced that was not to a banker.
A call saying no visit reads the most recent trace.
A visit is counted back from the most recent, which is visit one.
The answer names every visit kept by its time and the venue it was to.
A file the addon has written no such visit into is told what would write one.
A visit past the ones kept refuses the call.
No move, no phase and no paced dispatch is told, the addon recording none here.

definition: the command giving back a timing trace from one of the addon's vendor sessions
